emailDraft.subject: Groww Weekly Review Pulse
emailDraft.body:
Groww Play Store pulse (2026-W21): sentiment skews negative. Support, fees, and reliability dominate.

TOP 3 THEMES:
1. High brokerage charges — transparency gaps drive 1★ reviews.
2. Poor customer support — slow responses on Demat and payouts.
3. Withdrawal issues — delays spiked +28% WoW.

USER QUOTES:
• Charge mismatch on sell orders
• Withdrawals failing for days
• Crashes at market open

ACTION IDEAS:
1. Fee transparency before order confirm
2. Withdrawal status + SLA alerts
3. Support escalation for payout tickets

executiveSummary: LLM synthesis across 2,110 PII-safe public reviews: sentiment skews negative at 42%. Withdrawals (+28% WoW) and brokerage transparency are the top executive risks. Support non-response amplifies payout pain. Stabilize money movement and pre-trade fee disclosure this sprint.
